answer: Cross-Epoch Continuity Scoring. Each identity must appear in a minimum fraction of prior epochs with consistent action distributions; an oasis of dormant activity fails continuity. A gale of fresh identities each epoch is filtered because new keys start with zero continuity weight and earn no matching weight for several epochs. Reputation sits in a vault tied to continuity history, not key possession. Attacker cost: maintaining each sybil across N epochs with genuine behaviour, multiplying operational effort and exposure by the full window.
